q: what kind of company is this
are you a real estate brokerage
faqs.a:
{{name}} ({{legalName}}) is an independent real estate brokerage in {{market}}, California, founded in {{founded}}. We sell and lease homes on the South Coast, in {{hoods}}.

We stay small on purpose: every home is shown by the agent who listed it, and prices come with the sales behind them.

q: how long have you been in business
faqs.a:
We started {{name}} in {{founded}} with two agents and a rented office in Montecito, which makes {{years}} years in business. We're still on the same street, now with eleven agents.

Mara Ellison founded the firm after a decade restoring historic homes in Montecito, and she is still Principal Broker.

q: how many agents do you have
faqs.a: Eleven agents in one office on Coast Village Road. Four of them have public profiles on this site: Mara Ellison, Julian Okafor, Elena Varga and Daniel Reyes. For anyone else on the team, the main office can help: {{phone}}.

q: how are you better than other brokerages
faqs.a:
A few things we hold to:
- **One agent, start to finish.** The person who lists your home shows it, negotiates it and is at the closing.
- **Prices you can defend.** Every list price comes with the six to ten comparable sales behind it.
- **Small on purpose.** We turn down more listings than we take.
- **Fast answers.** Questions about a listing go straight to the listing agent. Our median reply last year was 38 minutes.
- **Private options.** About a third of the homes we sell never appear on this site.

q: how does it work working with you
faqs.a:
Five principles:
1. One agent, start to finish.
2. Prices you can defend, with the comparable sales shown.
3. Answers the same day.
4. Private when you need it.
5. Local before anything else: every agent lives in the area they sell.

q: how many homes have you sold
faqs.a: We've sold $1.2B in homes since {{founded}}. Our median time on market in 2025 was 17 days, against a county median of 34, and clients rate us 4.9 out of 5 across 312 verified reviews.
